mapper.select: SELECT emp_no, name, email, email_chk FROM admin ORDER BY emp_no DESC
SELECT emp_no, name FROM admin WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY emp_no DESC

SELECT d.id as draft_id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.created_date, d.updated_date, dcd.id as detail_id, dcd.appr_no, dcd.row_no, dcd.type, dcd.address, dcd.address_d, dcd.post_code, dcd.rsrc_code, dcd.area, dcd.cont_date_s, dcd.cont_date_e, dcd.chk_3, dcd.accu, dcd.deposit_amt, dcd.rent_amt, dcd.cont_amt, dcd.bigo, dcd.payment_date, dcd.lessor, dcd.lessor_name, dcd.lessor_account, dcd.lessor_bank, dcd.cust_code, dcd.created_date as detail_created_date FROM draft d INNER JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id WHERE d.mst_seq = #{mstSeq} AND (d.erp_reg IS NULL OR d.erp_reg = 'N') ORDER BY dcd.row_no

SELECT DISTINCT d.mst_seq, d.created_date FROM draft d WHERE d.mst_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.mst_seq != '' AND d.cust_reg_attempted = 'Y' AND (d.erp_reg IS NULL OR d.erp_reg = 'N') ORDER BY d.created_date ASC
